metaDescription: Lucoze runs records, appointments, GST billing, lab & pharmacy for clinics in Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Rourkela & Berhampur. ABDM-ready, DPDP-compliant, data in India.
h1Parts: , built to run the front desk.
lead: One platform for patient records, appointments, GST billing, lab and pharmacy — made for the way clinics in Odisha actually work. Records, the ABHA number and billing from the first visit.
intro: Odisha's health scene is growing fast — the Bhubaneswar–Cuttack corridor keeps adding new hospitals, specialty clinics and diagnostic centres, and patients travel in from Berhampur, Sambalpur, Puri and beyond. Lucoze puts patient records, appointments, GST-ready billing, lab reports and pharmacy stock on one platform, so the front desk stops juggling registers, Excel sheets and three apps. You can record the ABHA number at the first visit, keep records clean for BSKY and insurance claims, and pull a patient's history in seconds — whether they came in last week or last year from another district.
points: Records, appointments, GST billing, lab and pharmacy in one place — no more stitching together a booking app, a billing tool and a pile of registers.
ABHA number at the first visit
Record a patient's ABHA number during registration so it is on the file from day one, as Odisha's digital health push rolls out.
Keep documentation tidy for Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY), Ayushman Bharat (PMJAY) and private insurance so claims don't bounce back over missing paperwork.
All patient data sits in Indian data centres under DPDP 2023, and there's no lock-in — export to CSV or PDF whenever you want.
localContext: Front desks across Odisha run in Odia first, with Hindi and English in the bigger city hospitals — a receptionist in Saheed Nagar or a diagnostic centre in Cuttack's Buxi Bazaar shouldn't have to fight the software to register a walk-in. Lucoze runs in English, in short plain labels, and onboarding trains your team on your own patients, so a name, UHID or phone number pulls up the file. Support is remote-first from our team in Konnagar, Hooghly, with on-site help for larger hospital deployments.

faqs.q: Will an Odia-speaking front desk manage?
faqs.a: Yes. Lucoze's screens are in English, in short plain words a new receptionist can follow, and onboarding trains your front desk on your own patients, so the first week runs on your real day, not a demo.

faqs.q: Do you offer setup support in Odisha?
faqs.a: Our team is based in Konnagar, Hooghly (West Bengal), so support for Odisha is remote-first: video onboarding, hands-on data migration from your old registers or Excel, and WhatsApp and chat support. For larger hospital deployments we can arrange on-site help — just ask.

faqs.q: Where is our patient data stored?
faqs.a: In Indian data centres, handled under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023. There's no lock-in either — you can export your records to CSV or PDF any time, so the data is always yours to take with you.
